title: Party Can't Be Granted Interim Relief Merely Because Opposing Counsel Failed To Answer Court's Query: AP High Court
description: The Andhra Pradesh High Court has held that�a party cannot succeed on the weakness of the opposite party's case and must stand on the strength of its own case, observing that interim relief cannot be granted merely because the opposite party's counsel failed to answer a legal query posed by the Court. [2026 LiveLaw (AP) 132] Accordingly, it set aside a Single Judge's interim order in a land dispute, holding that the writ petitioners had to independently establish a prima facie case for the grant
